title: Make electronic conveyancing networks work with each other
action: Require the electronic lodgment networks used for property settlements to interoperate, so that each party to a transaction can use the network of their choice and new networks can compete with the incumbent.
why: Mandating electronic conveyancing cut settlement times, but without interoperability the first network keeps a near-monopoly because every party must join the network the others use.

evidence.source: NSW Productivity Commission White Paper 2021: Rebooting the economy
evidence.quote: Support the implementation of interoperability in the NSW e-conveyancing market as a matter of urgency.
